targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (metrics->>'latency_ms')::numeric) AS p99_latency_ms, avg((metrics->>'latency_ms')::numeric) AS avg_latency_ms FROM telemetry_events WHERE time > $__timeFrom() AND metrics ? 'latency_ms' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, source, sum((metrics->>'token_count')::numeric) AS total_tokens FROM telemetry_events WHERE time > $__timeFrom() AND metrics ? 'token_count' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, metadata->>'language' as language, avg((metrics->>'duration_ms')::numeric) AS avg_duration_ms FROM telemetry_events WHERE time > $__timeFrom() AND source = 'ephemeral-sandbox-polyglot' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, metadata->>'status' AS status, count(*) AS event_count FROM telemetry_events WHERE time > $__timeFrom() GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;
